Title: Public Preview: Web PubSub support for Socket.IO

Body.Content:
Azure Web PubSub for Socket.IO is a new capability that manages client connections for an application using the Socket.IO library.  This means you don't need to manage multiple Socket.IO servers or adapters, and you don't need to develop expertise in distributed systems - instead, you can focus on building real-time experiences.

Now you can easily migrate from self-hosted Socket.IO to a fully managed solution through Web PubSub for Socket.IO.
